Signature Topics
01

Beyond the Hype: Practical AI for Modern Agronomy

A technical yet accessible session on plant phenotyping, variable-rate fertilisation, and the practical data ethics of the modern autonomous orchard.

Takeaway: What plant phenotyping, variable-rate fertilisation and data ethics look like in a working, increasingly autonomous orchard.

Best for: Growers, agronomists, technical teams

Keynote (45–90 min) · Technical lecture · Online

02

Eyes of the Machine: Computer Vision in Post-Harvest Quality

A deep dive into automating quality control for agrifood produce. How non-destructive AI sensing ensures shelf-life, reduces waste, and standardises global trade.

Takeaway: How non-destructive AI sensing protects shelf-life, reduces waste and standardises trade.

Best for: Packers, fresh-produce businesses, quality and supply-chain teams

Keynote (45–90 min) · Technical lecture · Online

03

Invisible Barriers: The Female Founder’s Journey in AgTech

An empowering narrative on navigating the male-dominated intersection of Ag & Tech, and why diversity is a prerequisite for agricultural innovation.

Takeaway: Why diversity is a prerequisite for agricultural innovation, not a nice-to-have.

Best for: Conferences, leadership events, women-in-agrifood programmes

Keynote (45–90 min) · Panel · Online

04

The Silicon Soil: AI’s Role in Global Food Security

A high-level keynote for policy makers and investors on how AI is moving from laboratory experiments to essential global field infrastructure.

Takeaway: How AI is moving from laboratory experiments to essential field infrastructure.

Best for: Policy makers, investors, international forums

Keynote (45–90 min) · Panel · Online

05

The First Leaf: AI & Computer Vision in Forestry Nurseries

Transforming silviculture through automated seedling QC. How AI monitors viability and stress in the nursery to ensure higher survival rates, better timber quality, and more resilient reforestation at scale.

Takeaway: How AI monitors seedling viability and stress for higher survival rates and more resilient reforestation.

Best for: Forestry and nursery sector, research institutes

Technical lecture · Online

Questions, answered

Can you speak online or hybrid?

Yes — in person, online or hybrid.

Which languages?

I speak English, Ukrainian and Russian, and German at B1.

Do you tailor the talk?

Every session is customised. I don’t just deliver data; I deliver a perspective that resonates with the specific challenges of your region or sector.

Do you also train teams?

Yes — workshops and multi-week courses, with BASIS CPD points through Petiole Ltd, are on my team training page.

What does it cost?

Fees depend on format, travel and preparation. Send the date and audience and I'll reply with a quote within two working days.
